Toy Shop App Kit
Power Apps canvas kit · 4 apps · 12 screens · tablet 1366 × 768

Toy shop app kit

Four standalone Power Apps, each in its own visual style. Every app is self-contained: paste its files into a blank tablet canvas app and it works, with no images, connectors or data sources. Open “Set up this app” in any section for the steps.

Paper Toy Co.Cosmo KitsThe Toys That Made UsSpark Cube
Style: Papercraft Models

Paper Toy Co.

A kit shop for fold-it-yourself paper toys. Browse robots, critters, vehicles and blocks on a green cutting mat, then pack them into a kit box and place an order.

Good for: Craft shops, toy stores, classroom maker kits

Set up this app (3 screens, plus App.Formulas)
  1. In Power Apps, create a blank canvas app in Tablet format.
  2. Select App in the Tree view, choose the Formulas property and paste all of `App.Formulas.txt`.
  3. For each screen file below, copy the whole file, right-click any screen in the Tree view and choose Paste.
  4. Drag HomeScreen to the top of the Tree view so the app opens there, delete the empty Screen1, then save and press Play.

App.Formulas holds all papercraft art and the Toys catalogue (12 kits). Cart: colCart.

Style: Flat-Vector Science

Cosmo Kits

A space-science toy store with a friendly robot guide. Every product carries a “Did you know?” fact with a big number, so shopping doubles as a mini science lesson.

Good for: STEM toy shops, science museum gift shops, school fundraisers

Set up this app (3 screens)
  1. In Power Apps, create a blank canvas app in Tablet format.
  2. For each screen file below, copy the whole file, right-click any screen in the Tree view and choose Paste.
  3. Drag SpaceHomeScreen to the top of the Tree view so the app opens there, delete the empty Screen1, then save and press Play.

Kits load on SpaceShopScreen’s OnVisible (colSpaceKits, 6 kits). Cart: colCosmoCart.

Style: Editorial Essay Collage

The Toys That Made Us

An interactive history-of-play guide: six toys that changed childhood, told as newspaper clippings and halftone prints, with a quick quiz to test what you learned.

Good for: Museums and exhibitions, libraries, classrooms, brand storytelling

Set up this app (3 screens, plus App.Formulas)
  1. In Power Apps, create a blank canvas app in Tablet format.
  2. Select App in the Tree view, choose the Formulas property and paste all of `App.Formulas.txt`.
  3. For each screen file below, copy the whole file, right-click any screen in the Tree view and choose Paste.
  4. Drag StoryHomeScreen to the top of the Tree view so the app opens there, delete the empty Screen1, then save and press Play.

App.Formulas holds the Stories table (6 entries with print art). The quiz shuffles them each round.

Style: Product Launch Reveal

Spark Cube

A keynote-style launch and pre-order flow for one hero product: a dark stage reveal with spec callouts, a clean white specs page with finish picker, and a bag with checkout.

Good for: Product launches, pre-order campaigns, hardware or gadget brands

Set up this app (3 screens)
  1. In Power Apps, create a blank canvas app in Tablet format.
  2. For each screen file below, copy the whole file, right-click any screen in the Tree view and choose Paste.
  3. Drag LaunchScreen to the top of the Tree view so the app opens there, delete the empty Screen1, then save and press Play.

Everything is inline. Bag: colSparkBag; chosen finish: gFinish. Spark Cube is an invented product.
